title: —Mother dying come home father.
html_source: Stephen received this telegram while on an artistic missionary trip to Europe. The power of the death-mother to draw her son from Paris back to Ireland connects her power in depth and breadth to the sea as “our mighty mother.” Since this return trip disrupted Stephen’s budding life as an expat and contradicted his wish not to go back to Ireland, the telegram becomes a symbol of power and resentment. It is also a symbol of guilt for his absence in the wake of his mother’s condition and his denial to serve even at her dying request.
